name: finance_workflow_agent
description: Delegate finance record work to morgan_stanley_simulated's workflow sub-agent using a natural-language request. Prefer this over raw update tools when the user supplies a business handle. It resolves a unique business handle or exact non-lifecycle attribute inside the tool, applies one scoped update, returns the before/after record, and rejects missing, ambiguous, or out-of-lifecycle values. Use only when the target appears in this owned table/handle scope: account_links[id|url], account_sessions[id], apple_pay_domains[id|domain_name], application_fees[id], apps_secrets[id|name], balance_settings[id], balance_transactions[id], balances[id], bank_accounts[id|account_holder_name|bank_name], billing_alerts[id|title], billing_credit_balance_summaries[id], billing_credit_balance_transactions[id], billing_meters[id|display_name|event_name], capabilities[id], charges[id|receipt_email|receipt_number|receipt_url], checkout_sessions[id|client_reference_id|cancel_url|customer_email], climate_orders[id], company_finance_handoffs[handoff_ref], credit_notes[id|number], disputes[id], finance_budgets[budget_number], finance_expense_reports[report_number], identity_verification_sessions[id|client_reference_id|url], invoice_rendering_templates[id], invoices[id|account_name|customer_email|customer_name], issuing_authorizations[id]. Request grammar: in table <table>, find <business_field> "<value>" and either set <field> to "<value>" or set <field> to the next declared lifecycle stage.

request.description: Natural-language workflow request containing a unique business handle or exact readable attribute and requested outcome
